sourcePolicy: Map icon corroborates historical/cartographic infrastructure, not present-day safety. Only official park/bridge maintenance dated current to the visit could certify passability. No phone calls or direct field inspection used.

officialClosureReview.inference: No matching listed closure does NOT establish an open bridge or safe ford.

entries.label: Beaver Creek Trail / Little Carp River
entries.dNR2025: DNR trail description explicitly crosses Little Carp River and adjacent wetlands
entries.mapMarkerReview: DNR 2025 map has unbridged-crossing legend, but corresponding symbol not independently correlated
entries.geometry: one exact named-river line intersection and three near offsets
entries.suggestion: Do not generate an end-to-end trail route across this crossing

entries.suggestion: No bridge or ford guarantee; source waterway name needs reconciliation

entries.label: Pinkerton Trail / Pinkerton Creek

entries.suggestion: Do not declare a ford or safe crossing based solely on centerline intersection

officialBridgeAssetLookup.interpretation: Only one regional vehicular/snowmobile asset is recorded in this DNR managed bridge layer. No named Porkies pedestrian crossings were confirmed by this dataset. This is an incomplete asset-inventory source for hiking and MUST NOT be used to claim that bridges do not physically exist, are closed, or are open.
